_doc: Labeled synthetic sessions for the extractor eval. Each turn: user/assistant text, or a tool call with result. `expected` lists memories that MUST be extracted (kind + substring of text). Anything else extracted counts as a false positive. All content is synthetic. Procedure = a successful (non-error) shell command whose verb is build/test/lint/check/vet/clippy/fmt/plan/typecheck; install, run, apply, import, ls are not procedures. Optional per-session `"sidechain": true` writes the session as a subagent file (`<session>/subagents/agent-eval.jsonl`) with `isSidechain: true` on every record; its user turns are orchestrator instructions, so no preference, fact or user-speaker decision may be extracted from them (procedures, gotchas and assistant decisions still count). Procedure labels use the normalized core command (leading `cd x &&`, `export V=x;`, `V=x` stripped; cut at the first pipe/`;`/`&&`/redirect). Questions without a question mark yield nothing.

- Context: Mobile clients share NAT IPs.

- Context: Need bursts.
- Decision: Token bucket with 100 rps refill.
- Why: Allows short bursts.
